description: Given a target person, find the shortest warm-intro path through your engager network. Walks coworker (shared current company) + alumni (shared past company / school) edges. Up to 3 hops. Pure DB read — no LinkedIn pull, no credits charged.

max_hops.description: Max path length (1=direct, 2=one intermediate, 3=two intermediates). Default 2.
